variants.name: 01-filled-metal
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup.
Asset type: RuneNexus mobile game turret module screen design proposal.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and authoritative layout/theme reference.
Primary request: modestly improve visibility of ONLY the three action buttons currently labeled "장착", "분해 · 다이아 50", and "일괄 분해". These buttons are in the selected-module detail panel and the inventory count row below it.
Output one complete portrait UI screenshot mockup, same 440:900 composition/aspect ratio as reference, preferably at twice the resolution for clear presentation. No device frame, no labels above the screenshot, no design commentary inside the screenshot.
Absolute invariants: preserve ALL other screen elements, text, numbers, original 3D turret PNG art, central three equipped modules and connectors, selected-module panel dimensions and position, inventory heading/filters/count/modules, top draw buttons, upper turret selector, footer tabs, dark teal metal/rune visual theme. Keep the three edited action buttons at exactly their existing positions, extents, and relative width ratios. Do not shift any panel or change scrolling layout. Keep inventory grid visible. Do not change the selected module or item count. All changes restricted to those three button faces, borders, text and optional very small action symbols.
Text on the edited buttons must be legible bold Korean, verbatim: "장착", "분해 · 다이아 50", "일괄 분해". Preserve the diamond refund amount 50 and the centered readable hierarchy. Crisp pale text with clear contrast against the surface. Avoid white rectangular web buttons, bright red warnings, giant icons, heavy glowing halos, ornate protrusions, additional frames around the actions, new UI sections, watermarks, blur. Only subtle restrained game metal craftsmanship.
Variant 1 — FILLED METAL, strongest recommendation: keep existing chamfered metal silhouette but change the flat dim blue button interiors into softly lit, richly filled metal faces. The "장착" button has a restrained luminous teal-blue metal face, crisp pale cyan edge highlight, and bold white label. The "분해 · 다이아 50" button has a moderately warm dark copper-brown face, fine bronze bevel highlights, and pale ivory label, clearly distinct without appearing alarming. The wide "일괄 분해" button uses the same copper family slightly more subdued than individual disassemble, with a gently lighter face than the surrounding dark panel and centered ivory bold label. No action icons for this variant. Edges finely defined, subtle upper/lower surface contrast. A small practical visibility improvement, not a whole-screen redesign.
